was: Family campground near Berford Lake north of Wiarton (Bruce Peninsula); 123 elec/water sites incl 34 overnight/transient + 89 seasonal, max RV 50 ft; shallow sandy beach, boat launch, non-motorized boat rentals. Open May long weekend-Thanksgiving. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Kootenai County fairgrounds RV park at 482 E Dalton Ave, Coeur d'Alene (82-acre grounds). Full-hookup (W/S/E) sites, pull-throughs on request, fits big rigs incl 45-ft class A; clean showers, WiFi, dump station within 1000 ft; ~$60/night. Reservable online. Closed to public during some fairground events. --Claude
note: Kootenai County fairgrounds RV park at 482 E. Dalton Avenue in Coeur d'Alene, an easy drive or bike ride to the lake, mountain trails and shopping.  Full hookups at every site, pull-throughs on request, 3 tent sites, showers and Wi-Fi; a free public dump station is next door. --Claude

facilities.note: A free public dump station is next door, on Dalton Avenue.

was: Bonner County fairgrounds RV campground at 4203 N Boyer Rd, Sandpoint. 32 paved sites with 30/50-amp electric and water; pavilion, restrooms, hot showers, seasonal camp host, WiFi; ~$30/night. Regular overnight camping May-Oct plus limited electric-only winter sites; reservable online. Closed to public during scheduled fair events. --Claude
note: Bonner County fairgrounds campground at 4203 N. Boyer Road in Sandpoint, close to Ponderay, Schweitzer and Lake Pend Oreille: 32 paved sites 12 ft wide and 27-48 ft long with 30/50-amp power and water, hot showers and restrooms, a covered pavilion, Wi-Fi and a camp host on site in season.  Tents aren't allowed on the grass. --Claude

booking.note: Some dates are blacked out for events at the fairgrounds, the fair among them.

season.note: In winter a few sites rent month to month, by application to the fair office only.

facilities.note: The dump station is next to the fairgrounds, on Boyer Road.

was: Idaho Power (utility) recreation area on the Bruneau delta / south side of C.J. Strike Reservoir, 12 acres. 33 drive-in RV/tent sites with shared water, no electric hookups; vault toilets, fire rings, boat marina/ramp; seasonal dump at nearby CJ Strike WMA. Reservable online (camplife); 14-day limit. --Claude
note: Idaho Power park on 12 acres at the Bruneau delta, on the south side of C.J. Strike Reservoir at the end of Cottonwood Road near milepost 72 of Idaho 78, about 26 miles south of Mountain Home: 33 sites for RVs or tents with shared water and no power, vault toilets, fire rings, a marina, a waterfront walking path and a reservable picnic shelter.  Camp hosts are on site Friday to Sunday from early April to Labor Day.  Utility-run, so ownership is private. --Claude

booking.note: Book by 10 a.m. the day before; same-day online bookings aren't taken.

facilities.note: The seasonal dump station is at the nearby C.J. Strike Wildlife Management Area.

season.note: Water at the sites is off from October 15 to April 1.

discounts.note: Card payments only, one discount at a time: $3 a night off for campers over 60, $5 for current or retired military.
